text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The expensive-looking car drives off into
the
distance. Apparently, it's a private
vehicle that
belongs to Daiichi Ruby's
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm standing in front of a traditional
candy store
with an elderly woman and
Daiichi Ruby. I was
helping the former
after she fell earlier when the
latter
happened to pass by and offered us a
ride.

text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much, dearie. You've been
such a big
help. But with the state I'm in,
I don't think I'll be
able to open up the
store today...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the owner sighs, Daiichi Ruby eyes
the flyer
pasted on the storefront. It
reads "50th
Anniversary Sale!" and it's
dated for today.

text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
So many of our customers are planning
to visit
today. I'd hate to let them all
down, but there's
not much I can do...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's already a sizable crowd by the
doors. This
place definitely has more
than a few fans!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Madam, if it isn't too much trouble,
could you
pick out a selection of your
top sellers? And
Trainer, apologies for
imposing on you, but I
need you to go to
the bank.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
With such a large number of incoming
patrons, we
should make sure to have
enough change on
hand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I go convert some bills for coins at the
bank as I'm
asked, but the more time
passes, the more
nervous I feel. Daiichi
Ruby and the elderly owner
are the only
ones manning the store right now...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What's this about Ruby running a store?
Now
that's something I'd like to see.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suddenly find Mr. C.B, one of the more

free-spirited students of Tracen
Academy,
standing before me. I open up
to her about my
concerns.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, consider my fancy tickled. Maybe
I'll go
take a look!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. On second thought, it might not
be as
interesting as I thought. There's
nothing that girl
can't do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While Mr. C.B seems optimistic about
Daiichi
Ruby's capabilities, it's not
enough to assuage my
concerns, and I
hurry back to the candy store.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Have those two been battling this on
their own
the whole time?! Heading
inside, I find Daiichi
Ruby covering for
the owner at the cash register.
But that's
not all...

text_block_list.name: Energetic Old Man
text_block_list.text: Come on in, come on in!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
He's a longtime regular. I found his
information in
the customer database,
and he came in
straightaway after I
contacted him.

text_block_list.name: Trend-Chasing Girl
text_block_list.text:
So, like, what's the best thing to get
from here?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Old Man
text_block_list.text:
The red bean mochi here has been a
customer
favorite for years. It's stuffed
with red bean paste,
and the hint of
saltiness it provides is just
exquisite.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
He's quite knowledgeable about this
shop and its
products, so I've put him in
charge of customer
service. I'm handling
the till and everything else.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...We're seeing a lot of first-time
customers today.
We should put the
cheaper, easy-to-grab items
up front so
they'll be easier to spot. Can you help

me reorganize the shelves?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You exaggerate. This level of managerial

know-how is merely the standard
expected of any
member of my house.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although Daiichi Ruby deflects my
praise, she
seems to buzz with energy as
she does an
inventory count on the rice
crackers.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I ended up coming anyway. Hey,
there!
One red bean mochi for me,
please!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: See, Trainer? It's just like I said.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: See, Trainer? It's just like I said.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
We aren't particularly close with each
other, no.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ouch, that's cold. We've crossed paths
several
times, haven't we? Always
attending the same
functions because of
our parents.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Granted, you were always a lot busier
than I was,
so it's true we've had few
chances to speak.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, you're a perfect fit for this
shopkeeper
thing, huh? Just like you are
for everything else.
That's no way to
enjoy life, if you ask me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you for waiting. Here's your red
bean
mochi.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha. What an honor to be handed one
directly
from you. I'd better write home
about this.
Anyway, thanks! See you
around!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Mr. C.B. leaves, Daiichi Ruby
returns to her
tasks and completes them
all with sharp precision.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Many of these rice crackers are broken,
so I've
removed them from the shelves.
Could you take
them into the back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While carrying the defective crackers
into the
storeroom, I happen to see the
display case
Daiichi Ruby must've set up
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything has been carefully curated
and lined
up along the shelves in neat,
tidy rows. To all
appearances, it's
perfect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I praise Daiichi Ruby for her kindness in
helping
the candy store owner, who
seems overjoyed by
the assistance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I did it not to be praised, but because it
was the
proper thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me of that one function
we
attended as kids, where a girl spilled
juice all over
her skirt.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You went as far as to help her change,
but when
she tried to thank you, you
just said, "I only did
what was proper as
a member of my house."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I am always mindful of my actions so as
not to
bring shame upon my family.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yeah, I knew you'd say that.
Personally,
though, I think there's more
to it than that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I should get going. Thanks for
the mochi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Mr. C.B. leaves, Daiichi Ruby
returns to her
tasks and completes them
all with sharp precision.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Many of these rice crackers are broken,
so I've
removed them from the shelves.
Could you take
them into the back?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While carrying the defective crackers
into the
storeroom, I happen to see the
display case
Daiichi Ruby must've set up
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything has been carefully curated
and lined
up along the shelves in neat,
tidy rows. To all
appearances, it's
perfect.
